---

## The job

What single job should this bot do? Describe the outcome a person gets from it.

## What it receives

What does the bot start from? Examples include a GitHub issue, a pull request, a message in chat, or a scheduled trigger.

## What it produces

What is the exact deliverable? Describe the shape a person can read or evaluate.

## Where its authority ends

What must this bot never do on its own? Sending messages, approving work, merging, deploying, and spending money each need to be listed separately when they are out of scope.

## Category

Choose one: productivity, marketing, sales, ops, personal, or development.

## Required integrations

Which services must the bot read from or write to? State the read and write actions separately.
